name: core-trade-builder-neighbours
description: Rules audit (core): LRR 94 - in the action phase only neighbours transact (unless an ability lifts it). The engine's trade.propose refused it, but the Discord transaction builder only posted a 'friendly reminder' and sent the offer. Now sendOffer_ / acceptOffer_ refuse it (TransactionHelper.canTheseTwoTransact). Base: pbd1204 undo save 109 (action phase, Mentak active, no neighbours): Mentak builds an offer of 1 trade good to Arborec in the Discord builder and presses Send: no offer reaches Arborec.
